title: Learn track: ordered problem sets that each teach one concept
description: One hand-written file per track, content/tracks/<trackSlug>.json, checked by the reaction linter (lint-tracks) and compiled into catalogue.json by the catalogue build. See docs/schema-design.md section 6.1 and docs/SPEC.md section 5, Learn.

goal.description: One line: what the track teaches.

showcaseReactionSlug.description: One of the track's set items, drawn whole (product included) on the track's card.

problemSets.description: In the suggested order; a checkpoint, if any, comes last.

level.description: The curriculum level (docs/curriculum.md): first year, second year, third and fourth year, graduate.

curriculumCode.description: The track's code in docs/curriculum.md, e.g. F2: the level's letter (F, C, A, G) and its place in that level.

conceptCard.description: Opens the problem set: paragraphs (blank-line separated), **bold**, *italic*, lists; sub- and superscripts as Unicode characters.

conceptFigurePaths.description: Optional SVG figures, relative to the folder of the track file.

checkpoint.description: true: the track's checkpoint (reactions of earlier problem sets, shuffled, names hidden, daily scoring).

reactionSlug.description: Always plays the latest published version.
